errors.evidence: The figure contains four lines: a solid blue line for EU, a solid orange line for BG, and two red dashed lines. The description incorrectly states there are only two.

errors.text_span: Първата линия е с червен пунктиран стил и представлява страните от ЕС.
errors.evidence: The line representing the EU is blue and solid, not red and dashed. The description confuses the data line with the separate red dashed lines on the plot.

errors.text_span: В точката 2018, стойността на линията е 0,798.
errors.evidence: This sentence refers to the EU line. The correct value for the EU in 2018 is 0.8015. The value 0.798 corresponds to Bulgaria (BG) in the year 2020.

errors.text_span: Линията се изменя с нарастваща тенденция през целия период.
errors.evidence: This statement about the EU line is an incorrect over-generalization. The line first decreases from 0.7483 (2012) to 0.7300 (2014) before it starts to increase.

errors.text_span: Втората линия е с оранжев пунктиран стил и представлява България.
errors.evidence: The line representing Bulgaria (BG) is orange and solid, not orange and dashed.

errors.text_span: В точката 2012, стойността на линията е 0,5421. В точката 2014, стойността на линията е 0,6132.
errors.evidence: The description swaps the values for Bulgaria (BG) for the years 2012 and 2014. The correct value for 2012 is 0.6132, and for 2014 it is 0.5421.

errors.text_span: В точката 2020, стойността на линията е 0,8015.
errors.evidence: This sentence refers to the Bulgaria (BG) line. The correct value for BG in 2020 is 0.798. The value 0.8015 corresponds to the EU line in 2018.

errors.text_span: Линията се изменя с нарастваща тенденция през целия период.
errors.evidence: This statement about the Bulgaria (BG) line is an incorrect over-generalization. The line first decreases from 0.6132 (2012) to 0.5421 (2014) before it starts to increase.
The description completely omits the two red dashed lines that are present in the figure.
